_comment: hack.c domove_core(): a step at a safe monster that stands on a closed door. A neutral gnomish Healer teleports to the corridor end east of a locked door and creates two tame fog clouds; the second, amorphous, is placed on the door. Each step west spends do_attack()'s rn2(7) and then reaches test_move()'s closed-door arm, which stops the hero at the locked door before domove_swap_with_pet(); the first draw instead stops her with "is in the way". Independent of batch 5.
